value.rationale: A single iid ranking induces simultaneous local minimum and maximum counts. The result provides a structural sign reversal between long paths and every genuine complete branching tree at any finite height, with exact arity-dependent infinite-height correlation and asymptotic approach to opposite perfect-correlation extremes. This is a motivated dependence-law dichotomy for the initial round of a natural random-order graph process, not merely a textbook one-vertex moment.
